# LJL Link

> Free, open-source Mac app (Eclipse Public License 2.0) for DJs who play Serato DJ Pro. It runs from the club's USB stick without installation and sends deck data to LJ Link in the lighting booth: which track is on which deck, length, BPM, key, three-band waveforms and the running position (read from Serato's time display). Track names only if the DJ allows it. Status: alpha (tested locally, not yet in a club).

- Passive: does not control Serato and never touches controllers or MIDI. Reads only Serato's log, the loaded track file (on the Mac, for waveform, BPM and key) and the time display in Serato's window.
- Privacy: titles, artists and file names leave the Mac only with the DJ's OK (asked at the start, can be switched any time). File names, folders and audio are never sent. No account, no cloud, no telemetry, no internet connection.
- Connection: the file club.json next to the app holds the booth address and the club key (written by LJ Link when it prepares the stick; until the "Prepare stick" function is released, made by hand as described in the LJ Link wiki). If the booth's address changed, LJL Link finds LJ Link with Bonjour in the local network.
- Requirements: macOS 14 or newer, Apple silicon and Intel (universal app); Serato DJ Pro; LJ Link in the booth with the input for LJL Link. macOS asks for "Local Network" (find LJ Link, chat) and "Screen Recording" (only Serato's time display; without it everything except the running position works).
- Suite chat (alpha): one chat room for every suite program in the local network (LJ Link, VJ-Link, LJL Link) without a server; name and position; an EMERGENCY button shows a pop-up at the bottom right for everyone; can be switched off; messages are never saved or logged.
- Also: welcome screen, "Report a problem" (email to fehlermelden@nextphilm.de, diagnostic data without titles, file names or keys), menu bar icon, English and German.
- The app is ad-hoc signed but not notarized by Apple yet; a copy downloaded from the internet is blocked once on the first start (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway).
- LJL Link is an independent project that works with Serato DJ Pro. It is not an official product of, and is not endorsed by, any maker of DJ, lighting or music hardware or software, including Serato. Serato and Serato DJ Pro are trademarks of Serato.

## Guide

- LJL Link has no wiki of its own. The guide is in the LJ Link wiki: [Serato DJ Pro](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-serato.html) (German: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/de/wiki-serato.html) and [Use case: Serato on the DJ laptop](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-case-serato.html).
